note: Real historical crew. Roles and identities are public record (NASA, 1971) — not simulated.

members.name: David R. Scott
members.position_note: Piloted the Lunar Module Falcon to landing; walked and drove the Lunar Roving Vehicle on all 3 EVAs.

members.name: Alfred M. Worden
members.position_note: Remained in lunar orbit aboard Command Module Endeavour operating the SIM bay instruments; performed the first deep-space EVA on the return trip.

members.name: James B. Irwin
members.position_note: Walked and drove the Lunar Roving Vehicle alongside Scott on all 3 EVAs; experienced a documented cardiac arrhythmia shortly after lunar liftoff.
